Glance 2026.09.25 improves preview sizing and executable detail browsing.

- Add an option to disable adaptive window sizing in gallery mode, off by default.
- Preserve the current window size while resolving new preview content, then apply its final size without an intermediate reset or hiding an already visible window.
- Organize executable details into collapsible sections. Only Overview is expanded by default; each section uses a continuous background and switches its header and rows together.
- Remove redundant executable information tooltips and unused footer spacing while retaining virtualized detail rows.
